'''Chang Kai''' ({{zh|s=常凯}}; born August 1964) is a Chinese physicist currently serving as research fellow at the Institute of Semiconductors, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS).<ref>{{cite news|url=http://ah.ifeng.com/a/20191122/7841206_0.shtml |script-title=zh:2019中国科学院院士、中国工程院院士公布 这些安徽人上榜 |work=ifeng |date=22 November 2019 |accessdate=22 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Chang was born in [[Qianshan, Anhui]] in August 1964. In 1984 he graduated from [[Fuyang Normal University]]. In 1986 he graduated from [[Beijing Normal University]], earning his Doctor of Science degree. He was a postdoc at the State Key Laboratory of Superlattice, Institute of Semiconductors of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS). In 1998 he became a visiting scholar at the [[University of Antwerp]] in [[Belgium]], he remained there until 2001. He is now a research fellow at the Institute of Semiconductors, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS).<ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.sina.com.cn/o/2019-11-22/doc-iihnzahi2620473.shtml |script-title=zh:北师大物理学系1996届博士常凯学长当选中国科学院院士 |work=sina |date=22 November 2019 |accessdate=22 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 2004 [[State Natural Science Award]] (Second Class)
* 2013 Huang Kun Solid State and Semiconductor Physics Award ({{zh|s=黄昆固体物理和半导体物理奖|labels=no}})
* 2019 Academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.ifeng.com/c/7rnt6gRXMxD |script-title=zh:2019年中科院院士增选结果揭晓，64人当选，最小年龄42岁 |work=ifeng |date=22 November 2019 |accessdate=22 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref>
